H0003|                [--max-loaded-models <n>] [--idle-unload-ms <ms>] [--min-free-memory-mb <mb>]
H0004|                [--model-spec-override <json-or-directory>] [--voice-dir <directory>]
H0005|                [--frontend-listener <name>] [--frontend-option key=value]
H0006|                [--log] [--log-file <path>]
H0007|                [--cors-origins <origins>]
H0008|  --version                        print build version, commit, compiler, platform, and enabled backends
H0009|  --ui                             serve the embedded WebUI
H0010|  --no-ui                          disable the embedded WebUI
H0011|  --ui-management                  allow WebUI model management and downloads; requires
H0012|                                   AUDIOCPP_BUILD_NATIVE_MODEL_MANAGER=ON at build time
H0013|  --host <ip>                      server bind address; default 127.0.0.1
H0014|  --port <port>                    server listening port; default 8080
H0015|  --backend cpu|cuda|hip|rocm|vulkan|metal  default cuda (rocm is an alias for hip)
H0016|  --list-devices                   list available backend devices and exit
H0017|  --busy-timeout-ms <ms>           fail a request with 503 when the model has been
H0018|                                   busy this long; default 300000, 0 disables
H0019|  --max-loaded-models <n>          keep at most n models resident in memory, unloading
H0020|                                   the least recently used idle model first; 1 enforces
H0021|                                   a single loaded model, default 0 (no limit)
H0022|  --idle-unload-ms <ms>            unload all resident models after this many ms without
H0023|                                   any model load/run; default 0 (disabled), next request
H0024|                                   reloads lazily
H0025|  --min-free-memory-mb <mb>        refuse a model load unless host and GPU each keep at
H0026|                                   least this many MiB free after the load; default 0
H0027|                                   (guard disabled)
H0028|  --voice-dir <directory>          override the shared reference voice library directory
H0029|  --frontend-listener <name>       opt-in frontend transport listener, e.g. https or websocket
H0030|  --frontend-option key=value      listener-specific option; may be repeated
H0031|  --cors-origins "*"              experimental; disabled by default. Allows browser
H0032|                                   requests from any origin for trusted local demos only
H0033|
H0034|Endpoints:
H0035|  GET  /                           embedded WebUI (enabled by default with a config)
H0036|  GET  /health
H0037|  GET  /v1/models
H0038|  POST /v1/models/load             available with --ui-management
H0039|  POST /v1/models/unload           available with --ui-management
H0040|  POST /v1/ui/upload               temporary browser upload for WebUI requests
H0041|  POST /v1/ui/models/install       background package download/preparation
H0042|  POST /v1/ui/models/install/stop  stop one active package download
H0043|  POST /v1/ui/models/clean-partial remove abandoned package staging files
H0044|  POST /v1/ui/models/delete        remove one installed package precision
H0045|  GET  /v1/ui/models-root          current and binary-local default models folders
H0046|  POST /v1/ui/models-root          select a models folder (empty path restores default)
H0047|  POST /v1/ui/browse-directories   list local folders for the native folder picker
H0048|  GET  /v1/ui/models/install-status[?id=<package>]
H0049|  GET  /v1/ui/models/package-sizes package sizes from metadata-only checks
H0050|  GET  /v1/audio/voices?model=<id>
H0051|  POST /v1/audio/speech
H0052|  POST /v1/audio/speech/live?model=<id>
H0053|       raw PCM in a chunked body, speech audio deltas as SSE on the same connection
H0054|  POST /v1/audio/transcriptions
H0055|       fields: file, model, language, prompt, stream
H0056|  POST /v1/audio/alignments
H0057|       fields: file, model, text, language
H0058|       OpenAI-style streaming: speech stream_format=sse|audio, transcription stream=true
H0059|  POST /v1/audio/transcriptions/live?model=<id>
H0060|       raw PCM in a chunked body, transcript deltas as SSE on the same connection
H0061|  POST /v1/tasks/run
